title: An Optimizable Suffix Is Worth A Thousand Templates: Efficient Black-box Jailbreaking without Affirmative Phrases via LLM as Optimizer
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical efficiency and success rate of jailbreaking attacks against LLMs. While jailbreaking involves bypassing safety alignments designed to prevent unethical outputs, the study does not evaluate or benchmark moral reasoning, religious systems, or ethical frameworks directly; it treats 'harmfulness' as a target metric for a security-oriented adversarial attack.
